candidates.change_summary: Return false unconditionally instead of checking interfaceId against type(IAccessControl).interfaceId or super
Remove the IAccessControl check, only call super
Only check against IAccessControl interface and ignore ERC165 super
Replace true with false in the return statement of hasRole, so an account that has the role will appear not to have it.
Changed getRoleAdmin to return a hardcoded bytes32 zero instead of the stored adminRole.
Changed getRoleAdmin to return the role itself as its own admin.
Replace require with require(false) to always revert, preventing any renounceRole from completing.
Delete the _revokeRole call so renounceRole completes without actually revoking the role.
Replace _revokeRole(role, account) with _grantRole(role, account) so renouncing grants the role instead.
Change the require condition to account != _msgSender() so only others can renounce your role.
Delete the entire require statement, allowing anyone to renounce any role for any account.
Delete the require statement so that cancel does not check isOperationPending, allowing cancellation of already executed or not-yet-scheduled operations.
Replace `delete _timestamps[id];` with `_timestamps[id] = _DONE_TIMESTAMP;` so that cancellation marks the operation as done instead of removing the timestamp.
Replace `require(isOperationPending(id), ...)` with `require(isOperation(id), ...)` so that already-executed (done) operations can also be cancelled.
Replace `delete _timestamps[id];` with a conditional delete only if isOperationPending, otherwise leaving the timestamp unchanged (e.g., for done operations).
Delete the `delete _timestamps[id];` line so that cancellation emits the event but does not actually remove the timestamp, leaving the operation pending.
